scripts.build:portable: tauri build --no-bundle --features portable && powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $out='artifacts/portable'; if (Test-Path $out) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $out }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Join-Path $out 'data') | Out-Null; Copy-Item 'src-tauri/target/release/tiez-app.exe' -Destination (Join-Path $out 'tiez-app.exe') -Force; Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $out '说明.txt') -Value '本软件完全免费，严禁未经许可的第三方倒卖。`r`n`r`n便携版更新时，请从官网 https://tiez.name666.top 下载新版本，并替换原目录中的 tiez-app.exe；data 文件夹会保留你的数据。' -Encoding UTF8; Compress-Archive -Path (Join-Path $out '*') -DestinationPath (Join-Path $out 'tiez-portable.zip') -Force"
scripts.tauri:build:mac-intel: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" RUSTUP_HOME="$HOME/.rustup" CARGO_HOME="$HOME/.cargo" RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=stable-aarch64-apple-darwin tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin
scripts.release: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && node scripts/apply-app-version.mjs macos && tauri build
scripts.release:arm: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && node scripts/apply-app-version.mjs macos && tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.release:intel: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && node scripts/apply-app-version.mjs macos && tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin
scripts.release:all: npm run release:arm && npm run release:intel
